name: Other Fraud - Card-Absent Environment

required_evidence.description: Compelling Evidence 3.0 package: 2+ prior undisputed transactions (120-365 days before the disputed transaction) sharing 2+ of the same data elements (account/login ID, device ID/fingerprint, shipping address, IP address)

source_reference: Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 Merchant Readiness Guide, March 2023 (https://usa.visa.com/content/dam/VCOM/regional/na/us/support-legal/documents/compelling-evidence-3.0-merchant-readiness-mar2023.pdf). 2-of-4 rule: dispute condition 10.4 (first-party misuse), 2+ matching data elements from 2+ prior undisputed transactions 120-365 days before the disputed transaction.
